data.exact_reserve_text: The 2015 and 2016 years of account have seen positive claims experience and the RITC of 2015 has also resulted in a release of reserves, However, the loss experience has been worse than anticipated for the 2017 year of account due to the catastrophe events in the second half of the year. Reserves have been established in respect of Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (Gross: GBP 74,828k, Net: GBP 23,040k) and Californian wildfires (Gross: GBP 7,970k, Net: GBP 7,362k) in October and December.

prior_year_events.impact_description: RITC of 2015 yielded a profit for the Syndicate as the premium was below booked reserves, resulting in a release of reserves related to the 2015 underwriting year.
Positive claims experience on the 2015 year contributed to releases on prior years.
Positive claims experience on the 2016 year contributed to favourable development on prior years.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims reserves at 1 Jan 2017 were GBP 621.9m and closing gross claims reserves at 31 Dec 2017 were GBP 590.2m. The syndicate reports little net prior-year movement on gross reserves (triangle analysis shows effectively no aggregate prior-year movement), with favourable claims experience on the 2015 and 2016 years and a release associated with the 2015 RITC offset by catastrophe losses in H2 2017. Significant 2017 catastrophe reserves were established for Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (gross GBP 74.8m, net GBP 23.0m) and Californian wildfires (gross GBP 8.0m, net GBP 7.36m).

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year reserve movement is not explicitly stated in a single 'movement in prior year provision' note. A gross claims development triangle is present and diagonal comparison shows effectively no aggregate prior-year movement for underwriting years up to 2015 (hence prior_year_development_gbp_m set to 0.0). Some narrative statements reference net releases and RITC profit (GBP 49m) but those are net or relate to specific transactions; triangle formatting in the PDF parsing required inference for column alignment. Where exact gross movement was not explicitly provided, triangle-derived result was used (confidence 0.8).
